title: [dev-g] Upper left arrow in plugin preference doesn't work to go back to plugin
body:
When you select Cog wheel to access to a plugin preference (for plugins in hamburger menu), the upper left arrow to go back to the plugin doesn't work.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/52934600/159223051-66c1cc0e-633b-4850-8dd8-112b4d8b04d3.png)

comments.body: I confirm arrow don't work in all preferences windows
